g.text: The error tends uniformly to zero in the chart topology, in every characteristic.

text.style: font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #172b4d

g.text: The fixed field is dense; the target is affine. BA7

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #172b4d

g.text: Every nondiscrete-joint counterdatum must have, in each compact norming family:

text.style: font-size: 21px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #172b4d
font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #172b4d

g.text: or discrete groups with unbounded indices relative to the fixed c. BA8

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #172b4d

g.text: This proof assumes a common positive π and bounded discrete ramification.

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #9a3f00

g.text: Discrete joint topology, perfect positive characteristic and general nonfield overlaps remain open.

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #9a3f00

g.text: The full raw-fibre cohomology assertion is not settled by this theorem.
